activation: After P1 formal/E2E is closed or fails to produce qualifying online improvement; no concurrent long-running S6E9 training.
unique_hypothesis: Exact-income target rate mixes income identity and group-specific context composition. Invert the donor group sigmoid response curve to recover a composition-adjusted income logit shift.
distinctness: Not E13 group mean of prediction residuals; not v97 fixed generator margin; not v98 GAM init_score; not rank4 income-context interaction. Group-specific nonlinear inverse E_g[sigmoid(nuisance+s)] is the differentiating operation.
baseline: P1 verified 5fold A = unchanged V85 148-column LightGBM, seed42, same LightGBM 6 threads. Reuse exact saved P1 A OOF and fold models only if source/fold/seed hashes match; otherwise rerun A.
main_variable: Add exactly two composition features to V85: shift_g and shift_g - (logit(smoothed_purchase_rate_g)-logit(global_prior)). No other features or model parameters change.

context_nuisance.preprocessing: donor-only StandardScaler numeric and OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore) categorical
context_nuisance.donor_prediction: Fit nuisance on donor labels, evaluate nuisance on donor rows to build group composition; no query label or test pseudo-label.

composition_formula.shift_g: unique monotone solution curve_g(s)=p_g, Newton 12 steps, bounded [-6,6]

leakage_boundary.inner_cv: For each outer fit, five stratified folds seed 42+outer index; fit nuisance and group curve on inner donor, transform inner hold only. Full outer donor state transforms outer valid.
leakage_boundary.early_stopping: same V85 outer-valid 350-round early stopping; results labeled development

diagnostic_gate: B or fixed blend pooled AUC strictly greater than matched A, with 5/5 outer folds positive. +0.0001 research promotion separate.
stop_rule: If gate fails, close this fixed formula; no alpha, nuisance, encoding, seed or bin neighborhood search.
external_implementation_reference: heuljax/kps6e09-xgb-sample; public code uses GAM + composition curve inversion, not this simplified fixed additive nuisance implementation.
